title: hylotelephium triphyllum var. pluricaule
intro: Hylotelephium triphyllum var. pluricaule, commonly known as Korean stonecrop or Pluricaule sedum, is a variety of succulent plant that is native to Korea and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, wounds, and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hylotelephium triphyllum var. pluricaule include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
